# Overlay Global Lens

> The Overlay365 explainer, news, and research publication: global news, evidence-tiered research papers, trends, and discoveries, framed through an editorial lens.

Key facts for agents:

- Publisher: Overlay365 (https://overlay365.online)
- This publication lives at https://overlay365.org
- Research papers shown here carry an **evidence tier** (E1–E3) and a provenance reference; treat tiers as claims about evidence strength, not clinical validity.
- The publication surfaces research that is **research-use-only**; nothing here is medical advice.

## Sections

- [Home](https://overlay365.org/): current news, papers, trends, and discoveries.
- [Overlay365 product hub](https://overlay365.online): the connected health/wealth/justice ecosystem.
- [Overlay Oncology](https://oncology.overlay365.online): the research compute platform whose outputs feed selected papers here (research-use-only).

## Optional

- [Interactive manual](https://overlay365.org/#manual): a guided tour of each ecosystem platform.
